Commentary.Commentary: What does Friday hold in store? South Africa taking on Thailand at 3 pm local (0400 GMT), followed by the England-Pakistan clash at 7 pm local (0800 GMT). Join us on 28th February, 2020 for the Friday double header. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

That is it for the double header from Thursday. Australia manage to strut their stuff after a slow start to the tournament and have pumped up a net run rate of 1.23, better than any team in the group. But they have two wins. They need to win to go through and that victory has to come against New Zealand, which is a possible quarter-final.

Victorious Australian skipper, Meg Lanning, says that it was a good all-round performance, set right from the first ball. Praises the openers and then the bowlers. Admits that the Aussies wanted to come out and take the game to the opposition. On two instances of fielders clutching shoulders in the field, Meg smiles and says that she has not met the doctor yet, so hopes that everything is fine. On a possible quarter-final clash against New Zealand, Lanning says that they are a terrific opponent, playing some good cricket and is eager to play the game. States that is all World Cups are all about.

Bangladesh captain, Salma Khatun, says that Australia are a very good team with plenty of power-hitting batters. Rues her bowlers for not bowling well. Admits that 190 was a big target. On being hit around the park, Salma says that her bowlers bowled way too short while Australia were accurate on lines and lengths. Is eager to play New Zealand and Sri Lanka and is not too perturbed with two losses on the trot.

ALYSSA HEALY HAS BEEN NAMED THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH. She says that they wanted to get on top of the bowling and they were not doing that in the earlier games. Adds that they practiced a lot in the nets and the practice paid off. Says that they figured out to which area the wind is blowing and they made full use of that.

Perfect practice game for Australia. It was not at all dissimilar to a warm-up game and the openers raked up confident half centuries, setting up their country's best opening stand in T20Is. And then, with the ball, barring one dropped catch from Ashleigh Gardner, Meg Lanning ensured that her team was performing with precision. Megan Schutt smiled her way to three wickets while Jess Jonassen got two towards the end. Disappointing for Bangladesh. Given the way they fought against India, one would have expected a better show. Please stay tuned for the presentation...
An 86-run drubbing for Bangladesh. Their pity ends. It was as if they never turned up for this game. They were listless in the field and chasing 190, they just gave up.
That is it! Australia have won the game! Floated on middle, Fahima flicks it to the deep mid-wicket region for a single. AUSTRALIA WOMEN WIN BY 86 RUNS.
Nahida Akhter is the last player in.

OUT! RUN OUT!  Yes, it is a team hat-trick and Tul Kubra is out of his crease. Floated on off, Tul Kubra drives it to the cover region and takes off for a single. Meg Lanning collects the ball and throws it to Jonassen. Jess whips the bails off and the third umpire is called for. The replays roll in and they show that Tul Kubra was out of her crease.
Another run out appeal! Is this a team hat-trick? Referred upstairs. Yup. 3 wickets in 3 balls for Australia.
Khadija Tul Kubra walks in at number 10, replacing Salma Khatun.

OUT! RUN OUT! The skipper has been stranded on the middle of the pitch. Comedy of the errors. Fullish on the pads. Salma looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW made but nothing from the umpire. The ball goes to point. Salma wants the run and but the non-striker is not interested. Salma waits in the middle of the pitch as Delissa Kimmince, the substitute, throws it to the keeper, who whips the bails off. She is nowhere in the picture.
Salma Khatun is the next batter in.
OUT! BOWLED! Full and straight, Jahanara looks to swing across the line but misses. The LED bails illuminate again. Second wicket for Jess.
Outside off, swung towards long on for a run.
Low full toss, outside off, pushed towards long off for a single.
Jahanara Alam is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another one bites the dust and the last rites are being prepared for Bangladesh. Full delivery on middle, Fargana looks to sweep but it takes the top edge and goes up in the air. Healy comes off her mark and then manages to pouch it safely. Third wicket for Schutt. She finishes with figures of 4-0-21-3.
Good length ball outside off, Khatun looks to heave it away but it takes the outside edge and it goes towards deep point for a single.
Full on middle, Hoque drives it to long on for a single.
On middle, played towards mid on for single.

NOT OUT! The ball has hit the ground The fielder was not confident and the on-field umpires have taken it upstairs. Short ball on middle, Khatun pulls it to mid-wicket where Sutherland dives forward to take the catch. She gets up and is not confident that she has taken it cleanly. The on-field umpires take it upstairs after a discussion. The replays roll in and they show that the ball has bounced just in front.

That is a stinger! Or not? The fielder herself shakes her head, or perhaps she says she is not sure, so the umpires refer it upstairs. The soft signal is NOT OUT. Interestingly, Fahima started to walk but then was stopped. Here come the replays. Seems like the ball has bounced just in front of Annabel Sutherland.
Play and a miss! Good length ball outside off, Khatun looks to heave it away but misses to get any bat on it.
Megan Schutt to bowl out. 3-0-18-2 so far.
Outside off, pushed to cover for a dot.
Loopy one on middle, Khatun sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. They pick up a single.
Fargana comes down the track and then converts this ball to a full toss on middle to long on for a single.
Fahima Khatun is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Straight to the fielder! It is basically catching practice. Floated on middle, Rumana bends on her knees and then looks to slog sweep it. She does not get the required elevation on it and neither the distance. The ball goes to Georgia Wareham at deep square leg.
Floated on off, Fargana drives it to long off for a single.
This is driven straight back for a single.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a couple.
Full and outside off, Fargana goes for the slog but gets a thick inside edge onto her pads.
A short ball, outside off, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Tossed up outside off, thank you very much, says Rumana. Comes down the track and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Fuller one on middle, Ahmed scoops it to fine leg for a single.
Full on middle, Ahmed pushes it to mid on.
Short ball on middle, Ahmed pulls it to the deep square leg region and collects a couple.
Another length ball outside off, Hoque taps it to third man for a single.
On off, pushed to the point region.
Good length ball outside off, Ahmed guides it to third man for a single.
Megan Schutt is back into the attack. 2-0-13-2 so far.
Floated on middle, Ahmed scooped to fine leg for a single.
Floated on the pads, Hoque flicks it to the deep square leg region for a single.
Full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, swept off the inner half through fine leg for a single.
Full and down the leg side, Rumana looks to sweep but gets a top edge. A couple taken.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Jess Jonassen is back on.
Rumana Ahmed is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! After a partnership, Bangladesh have lost a wicket. It is Nicola Carey who has provided the breakthrough. Good length ball on off, Sultana looks to heave it to the off side, but takes an edge which goes towards cover. Meg Lanning, the skipper takes the simplest of catches and the Aussies inch closer and closer to victory.
Swing and a miss! Short ball outside off, Sultana looks to pull but fails to get any bat on it.
EDGY! Good length ball outside off, Hoque looks to cut but it takes the bottom edge and it goes towards third man. A single. 50-RUN STAND IS UP!

FOUR! Full on middle, Fargana whips it through mid on. Jess Jonassen dives to her right at that position but lands awkwardly on her right shoulder. She now clutches her shoulder in pain. So in the span of two overs, Australia have two fielders clutching their shoulders.
On off, Sultana drives it to mid off and takes a single.
Fullish outside off, Sultana drives it through the cover region and picks up a couple before the fielder comes across and cleans it up.
Nicola Carey is back on. 2-0-8-0 so far.
FOUR! Whipped away! Full on middle, Hoque whips it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Full on off, driven to mid off.

Excellent piece of fielding! Short delivery outside off, Hoque cuts it to the deep point region. Mooney runs across from deep cover and makes a dive to her left to stop the ball. Stops a couple of runs but she lands awkwardly on her right shoulder. Winces in pain.
FOUR! Creamed! Fullish ball on off, Fargana drives it past the bowler and into the fence at long off.
Short ball outside off, Huque pulls it and it lands over the mid on fielder. The batters complete a couple.
Short ball on middle, Sultana pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Annabel Sutherland is back on. 2-0-8-1 so far.
Full down the leg side, Sultana sweeps it to fine leg for a run.
BEATEN! Shorter in length outside off, Sultana looks to cut but fails to make any connection to it.
Flatter outside off, Hoque punches it to the deep cover region for a single.
Loopy on middle, Sultana sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
On off, punched to the off side.
WIDE! Tossed up ball down the leg side, Sultana looks to sweep but misses. Wide signaled.
Full delivery on the pads, Sultana looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. No run.
BEATEN! Flatter one outside off, Hoque looks to cut but misses to get any bat on it.
Floated on middle, Hoque prods forward and defends it out.
On middle, Sultana pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Short ball on middle, Sultana pulls it towards deep square leg. The fielder runs across from deep mid-wicket and dives but the ball goes into the fence. 50 up for Bangladesh.
Flatter on middle, Hoque plays it back to the bowler.
Flatter one outside off, Hoque plays it to deep cover for a single.
Jess Jonassen is into the attack.
Wareham tosses this one up on middle and leg, Sultana defends this out. 45/3 at the halfway mark. Need 145 runs more in the last 10 overs.

Bangladesh's head coach, Anju Jain, says that the plan is to get as close as possible to the target. Adds that they have discussed to break the target into blocks of 5 overs each. Stresses that the girls are full of confidence but for today, believes that Australia batted really well but laments the missed opportunities. Admits that they would have preferred to play more matches and series before coming into the World Cup.
Flatter one outside the off stump line, Hoque pushes it to the off side for a single.
Outside off, punched to deep cover for a single.
Shorter in length outside off, Hoque cuts it to the point region.
Flatter one outside off, Farqana punches it to deep point for a single.
BEATEN! Short delivery outside off, Hoque looks to cut but fails to get any bat on it.
Georgia Wareham is on now.
Good stop! Good length ball outside off, Sultana drives towards the cover region where the fielder dives to make a good stop. Saved some run there.
Length ball outside off, Sultana punches it to cover.
Another short one on the pads, Hoque pulls it to backward square leg for another single.
Good length delivery on middle, Hoque defends it back to the bowler.
Length ball on the pads, Sultana flicks it to the fine leg region for a single.
FOUR! Driven nicely. Carey dishes a fullish delivery outside off, Sultana leans forward and creams the drive through the cover region for a boundary.
FOUR! Poor delivery! Short ball down the leg side, Fargana pulls it to the fine leg region for a boundary. Good end to the over.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Hoque looks to pull but misses. Wide signaled.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
On middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Nothing of the Free Hit! Short delivery outside off, Sultana looks to pull but misses and the ball goes to short third man off her ribs.
FREE HIT COMING up!

Another short one around middle and off, Sultana is early into the shot as she looks to pull. She gets hit on the groin and the ball rolls to short third man. The third umpire intervenes and then the on-field umpire signals it a NO BALL.
Short ball on middle, Sultana comes down the pitch and then looks to pull. She misses and gets hit on the body.
Short delivery around off, Sultana pulls it to mid-wicket.
Carey bowls a full delivery on off, Hoque lunges and pushes it to cover.
Outside off, punched to deep cover for a single.
Fullish on middle, Nigar pushes it to mid on.
Another one on a length, Sultana pushes it to point.
Good length delivery outside off, Sultana taps it to third man for a run.
Full delivery on off, Fargana prods forward and then defends it to the cover fielder.
Nicola Carey into the attack.
Short ball on middle, Sultana pulls it to mid-wicket. End of another successful over from Sutherland. Bangladesh finish at 27/3 in the Powerplay, nearly half as compared to Australia's 53/0.
Length on off, guided to third man for a single.
Fargana Hoque is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Strangled down the leg side! Sutherland enters the bowling fray and picks up a wicket. Bangladesh slip further down the barrel. Short ball down the leg side, Sanjida looks to pull but the ball takes the gloves and goes straight into the hands of Healy. She does not make a mistake and the umpire raises his finger. Islam starts walking back without even thinking about the review.
Good length ball on off, Islam defends it to the off side.
Length ball on off, Sanjida taps it to point.
Sutherland starts with a full delivery on middle, Islam pushes it to mid on.
Annabel Sutherland given the ball now.
Full on middle, Sultana defends it out.
On a length outside off, punched to point.
Length ball on off, Sultana pushes it to the cover fielder.

DROPPED! Gardner drops a sitter! This has been a night of dropped catches. Bangladesh put down many and now it is the turn of the Aussies. Short ball on middle, Islam looks to pull but it takes the top edge and goes towards fine leg. Gardner runs ahead a little and takes the catch but is a bit too far from the ball. It goes straight in and then pops down. The batters take a single.
Short ball down the leg side, Islam pulls it to the fine leg region where Gardner comes across from fine leg, dives and makes a stop. Two taken.
On middle, Islam defends it back to the bowler.
Nigar Sultana walks in at number 4, replacing Sanjida.

OUT! TIMBER! What a ripper of a delivery from Megan Schutt. Bangladesh lose both their openers and are struggling big time. This is brilliant bowling from Schutt. Fullish delivery on off, angling in sharply, Sultana looks to flick but misses. The ball goes and hits the middle stump. That was some delivery. Australia eight wickets away. End of a brilliant over from Schutt. 2 wickets from it.
EDGY FOUR! Length ball outside off, Sultana looks to guide it but takes the edge going to the third man fence.
Sanjida Islam comes in at number 3, replacing Murshida.

OUT! CAUGHT! Excellent catch from Jess Jonassen. Back of a length ball on middle, Khatun looks to heave it to the leg side but does not time it well at all. Jonassen at mid on, moves to her left and takes an excellent tumbling catch, over her head. Good start for Australia. They continue to rule the roost here.
Full on off, Khatun pushes it to the mid off fielder.
FOUR! Very well played! Fullish around off, Khatun lifts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
On middle, flicked to the leg side for another dot.
FOUR! Full on middle, Sultana flicks it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Top edge but safe! Short ball around middle, Khatun looks to pull, taking the top edge and the ball goes to fine leg. Another single.
Length ball on off, Sultana guides it to third man for a single.
Short ball on off, Khatun looks to pull but it takes the top edge and goes towards the point region. The fielder takes the catch but it does not matter as it was a Free Hit. A single.

No Ball! Third umpire comes into play. Full delivery down the leg side, Khatun looked to flick but missed and got hit on the pads. There was nothing from the on-field umpire but the third umpire intervened and instructed the replay to be checked. Sure enough, Perry had overstepped. A Free Hit will follow.
Excellent bowling! Perry bowls an inswinging yorker on the pads, Khatun looks to flick but misses. Just missed the leg stump.
Length ball on the pads, Khatun looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls to the off side but another dot ball.
FOUR! Pulled away nicely! Short ball on middle, Sultana pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. First one of the innings.
Play and a miss! Fullish delivery outside the off stump line, Sultana looks to push but fails to get any bat on it.
On off, Sultana defends it off the back foot.
Fullish outside off, Khatun drives it to mid off for a single.
On a length on off, Khatun blocks it to cover.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, Khatun looks to defend but fails to get any bat on it.
Megan Schutt will bowl from the other end.
Full on middle, Khatun flicks it to mid-wicket for a single. Good start from Perry. Just 2 runs from it.
Very full delivery outside off, Khatun pushes it to the point fielder.
Length ball on off, Khatun defends it off the back foot to cover.
Full delivery on middle, Khatun pushes it back to the bowler.
Good length ball on the pads, Sultana looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls to square leg and the batters steal a leg bye.
Almost a wicket first ball. Perry starts with a length ball around off, Sultana looks to defend but it takes the inside edge and goes towards the leg side.
We are back for the chase! The Australian players make their way out to the middle in defense of 189. Shamima Sultana and Murshida Khatun follow them out. Ellyse Perry will start with the ball.
